evidence: Clicking "New Resume" created a blank "Untitled Resume" editor with empty Contact/Summary/Experience/Education/Skills fields; it appeared in the dashboard list after navigating back.
Template tab offers Modern, Classic, Minimal presets; selecting Classic marked it active and immediately changed the Live Preview layout/style.

Entered Full Name/Email/Phone/Location, Summary, Work Experience (company/title/dates/description), Education (institution/degree/field/dates), and Skills; all fields accepted input and reflected in the preview.

Sections tab allows reordering (up/down arrows moved Education above Work Experience) and renaming headings (renamed "Skills" to "Core Competencies"); both changes reflected immediately in Live Preview.
Live Preview panel accurately mirrors all entered data and template/section changes; Show/Hide Preview toggle works correctly.
Card menu "Duplicate" created "UX Designer Resume - TechCo (Copy)"; "Rename" opened a dialog that successfully renamed it to "UX Designer Resume - StartupX".
Multiple distinct resume versions (original, duplicate, renamed) coexisted in the dashboard list simultaneously, each independently editable.
Search box filtered list to only "Marketing Manager Resume" when typing "Marketing"; sort dropdown "Title A-Z" correctly reordered cards alphabetically; "Newest First" sorts by date.

issue: No validation for invalid/conflicting date ranges
actual: Setting an Experience entry's Start Date to 2021-01 and End Date to 2019-01 (end before start) was accepted with no error or warning; the Live Preview silently displayed "Jan 2021 - Jan 2019".

evidence: Date fields are native HTML type="month" inputs; attempting to set a non-conforming value ("not-a-date") via direct value assignment was rejected by the browser and reset to empty, while valid "YYYY-MM" values were accepted.

issue: No persistent storage; data lost on reload
actual: After creating/renaming/duplicating resumes (new titles "UX Designer Resume - TechCo", "UX Designer Resume - StartupX", "Untitled Resume" all visible in the list), reloading the page at http://localhost:7005/ caused all of them to disappear, leaving only the original 3 seed resumes. Inspection via browser_evaluate showed both localStorage and sessionStorage are empty, confirming no persistence mechanism is used.

evidence: Every edit (contact fields, summary, experience, education, skills, template choice, section order/headings) was reflected in the Live Preview panel immediately within the same snapshot after the action, with no delay or stale/incorrect content observed.

Moving Education above Work Experience via the up-arrow button and renaming "Skills" to "Core Competencies" both took effect instantly in the Sections list and Live Preview with a single action, no lag or extra steps required.

actual: There is no explicit Save button; edits are persisted to the in-memory list only when navigating back to the dashboard. After editing a Full Name field and clicking the back button, the resume appeared in the dashboard list, but the "Notifications" region remained an empty list with no toast, message, or other success feedback shown at any point during editing, renaming, or duplicating.

evidence: Opened the pre-loaded "Marketing Manager Resume" (2 experience entries, 2 education entries, 5 skills, summary, LinkedIn) and its Classic-template Live Preview rendered all sections and content fully with proper headings and structure, no truncation or overlap evident in the accessibility tree.

All entered fields (name, email, phone, location, summary, experience company/title/dates/description, education institution/degree/field/dates, skill) remained present and correct when navigating across tabs and template changes within the session.

Changed Full Name in the duplicated "UX Designer Resume - StartupX" to "Jane Smith (StartupX Version)"; reopening the original "UX Designer Resume - TechCo" still showed the unchanged "Jane Smith", confirming independent per-version storage.
Renamed resume title "UX Designer Resume - StartupX" matched exactly between the dashboard card heading and the editor page header/title button after opening the resume.
